extDescription.message: Disappear from Google Meet, Teams and Zoom web calls with a finger snap. Snap again to return.

noCalls.message: Open a call in Google Meet, Microsoft Teams or Zoom in this browser and turn on your camera.

notAttached.message: Thanos Snap isn't attached to this tab yet. Reload the tab.

unsupported.message: This browser doesn't support the video processing Thanos Snap needs.

camOff.message: No camera yet. Turn your camera on in the call. If it was already on, turn it off and on again.

snapDetectHint.message: Listens for the sound of a snap through your microphone (it doesn't watch your hand). Runs locally. Muting the call does not stop it.

doubleSnapHint.message: Fewer accidental triggers in noisy rooms.

thanosHint.message: Turn to dust instead of fading out.

noCamera.message: Turn on your camera in the call first.

capturing.message: Wait until the room capture finishes.

captureFailed.message: Couldn't capture the room. Is the camera on?

micError.message: The microphone isn't available for snap detection.

firstTest.message: First time? Turn off the call's own background effects and check the result with another participant.

privacy.message: Camera effects and snap detection run locally. Settings and the room snapshot stay in your browser.

testIntro.message: Try Thanos Snap without a call. Your camera is processed locally and nothing is sent anywhere.

learnListening.message: Snap 3 times now, about a second apart… $COUNT$/3

learnDone.message: Got it! Your snaps are learned.

learnFailed.message: Didn't hear clear snaps. Snap louder or closer to the mic and try again.

learnNeedsMic.message: Turn on snap detection (with the camera on) first.

heard_quiet.message: Heard a sound, but too quiet ($DB$ dB). Raise sensitivity or teach your snap.

heard_dull.message: Heard a sound, but it wasn't sharp enough to be a snap. Try Teach my snap.

heard_long.message: Heard a sound, but it lasted too long to be a snap.
